user.title: SkyRC MC3000
user.description: Select your SkyRC MC3000 charger. If no charger is found, enter the BLE address manually.

error.no_devices_found: No SkyRC MC3000 charger found. Make sure the charger is powered on and not connected to the SkyRC mobile app.

abort.already_configured: This SkyRC MC3000 charger is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one MC3000 charger is supported.

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Read the current MC3000 state and all four slots.

start_slot.name: Start slot
start_slot.description: Start the program already uploaded or configured on the charger. The expected battery chemistry is checked before starting.

stop_slot.name: Stop slot
stop_slot.description: Stop charging or discharging in the selected slot. Any automatic test running in that slot is cancelled.

start_all.name: Start all slots
start_all.description: Check all four slots and start their current programs. Selecting a saved profile does not upload its settings to the charger.

stop_all.name: Stop all slots
stop_all.description: Stop all four slots individually and cancel their automatic tests.

write_program.name: Upload complete program
write_program.description: Upload all program parameters to one slot without starting it. Values are validated together for the selected chemistry and mode. Save a named profile to reuse the same settings.

battery_type.name: Battery chemistry
battery_type.description: Must match the battery physically installed in the slot.

operation.name: Mode
operation.description: Available modes depend on the chemistry. Break-in is supported for NiMH, NiCd, and Eneloop.

capacity.name: Capacity limit
capacity.description: Capacity limit in 100 mAh steps; 0 disables the limit. Break-in requires a rated capacity of at least 100 mAh.

charge_current.name: Charge current
charge_current.description: Normally 0.05–3 A. Break-in uses a capacity-derived current of 0.1 C, up to 3 A.

discharge_current.name: Discharge current
discharge_current.description: Normally 0.05–2 A. The charger permits up to 1 A per slot when discharging multiple lithium batteries. Break-in uses 0.2 C.

charge_voltage.name: Charge termination voltage
charge_voltage.description: Charge termination or storage target voltage. Allowed limits depend on chemistry and mode.

discharge_voltage.name: Discharge termination voltage
discharge_voltage.description: Discharge termination voltage. Allowed limits depend on chemistry.

charge_end_current.name: Charge termination current
charge_end_current.description: Must not exceed the main charge current. Refresh, cycle, and Na-ion require at least 10 mA; use the main current to disable current reduction.

discharge_end_current.name: Discharge termination current
discharge_end_current.description: Must not exceed the main discharge current. Refresh, cycle, and Na-ion require at least 10 mA; use the main current to disable current reduction.

cycle_time.name: Rest after charge
cycle_time.description: Rest duration after charging, in minutes.

cycle_type.name: Cycle sequence
cycle_type.description: 0: charge/discharge; 1: charge/discharge/charge; 2: discharge/charge; 3: discharge/charge/discharge. For break-in: 0 is charge/discharge/charge and 1 is discharge/charge/discharge.

delta_v.name: Negative delta voltage
delta_v.description: Voltage-drop termination for NiMH, NiCd, and Eneloop in charge, refresh, or cycle modes. Ignored for other chemistries.

trickle_current.name: Trickle current
trickle_current.description: Trickle current for NiMH, NiCd, and Eneloop; 0 disables it. Ignored for other chemistries.

maintenance_voltage.name: Restart voltage
maintenance_voltage.description: Voltage threshold for restarting charge; 0 disables it. Allowed limits depend on chemistry.

protection_temperature.name: Temperature protection
protection_temperature.description: Stop temperature from 20 to 70 °C. Set to 0 to disable temperature protection.

protection_time.name: Time limit
protection_time.description: Time limit in minutes; 0 disables it. Break-in uses the charger fixed timing.

discharge_time.name: Rest after discharge
discharge_time.description: Rest duration after discharging, in minutes.

save_profile.name: Save profile
save_profile.description: Create or update a named profile in Home Assistant. This action does not send commands to the charger or start any slots.

name.name: Name
name.description: A unique name containing 1 to 60 characters.

program.name: Complete parameters
program.description: An object containing battery_type, operation, and every numeric field of Upload complete program, without slot. The Programs dashboard offers a form editor.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Provide an existing profile ID to edit it. Omit this field when creating a profile.

revision.name: List revision
revision.description: Optional concurrent-change check using the revision attribute of the profile library sensor.

delete_profile.name: Delete profile
delete_profile.description: Delete a profile from the Home Assistant library and clear its saved slot selections. Settings already uploaded to the charger remain in effect.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: The id of the desired profile in the profiles attribute of the profile library sensor.

select_profile.name: Select slot profile
select_profile.description: Save a profile selection for one slot in Home Assistant. Use Upload saved profile to send its settings to the charger.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: The id of the desired profile in the profiles attribute of the profile library sensor.

apply_profile.name: Upload saved profile
apply_profile.description: Upload one saved profile to the selected slots without starting it. Stop the slots before uploading. Specify either one slot or a list of slots.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Profile to upload. If omitted, the saved selection of the first specified slot is used.

slots.name: Multiple slots
slots.description: A list of integer slot numbers, for example [1, 2, 3, 4]. Specify this field or a single slot.

validate_only.name: Validate only
validate_only.description: Validate the saved parameters and return them in the response without sending commands to the charger.

save_cell.name: Save battery
save_cell.description: Create or update a physical battery record for measurements and reports. Enter the rated capacity and permitted settings from the battery specifications.

name.name: Name or label
name.description: Name of this physical battery, from 1 to 60 characters.

capacity_mah.name: Rated capacity
capacity_mah.description: Nominal capacity used to calculate test currents and compare measured capacity with rated capacity.

charge_current.name: Maximum charge current
charge_current.description: Maximum permitted current during a test. The actual current may be lower based on rated capacity.

discharge_current.name: Maximum discharge current
discharge_current.description: Maximum permitted current during a test. Parallel testing uses at most 1 A per slot.

charge_voltage.name: Charge termination voltage
charge_voltage.description: Set according to the battery chemistry and specifications.

discharge_voltage.name: Discharge termination voltage
discharge_voltage.description: Set according to the battery chemistry and specifications.

storage_voltage.name: Storage voltage
storage_voltage.description: Required for chemistries that support storage mode; ignored for other chemistries.

color.name: Label color
color.description: A color in #RRGGBB format, for example #3b82f6.

favorite.name: Favorite battery
favorite.description: Mark this battery as a favorite.

cell_id.name: Battery ID
cell_id.description: Provide an existing record ID to edit it. Omit this field when creating a record.

revision.name: List revision
revision.description: Optional concurrent-change check using the cell_revision attribute of the battery library sensor.

delete_cell.name: Delete battery
delete_cell.description: Delete a physical battery record and its slot assignments. Cancel any active or paused tests for this battery first.

cell_id.name: Battery ID
cell_id.description: The id of the desired record in the cells attribute of the battery library sensor.

assign_cell.name: Assign battery to slot
assign_cell.description: Identify the physical battery installed in a slot. One battery can only be assigned to one slot. This action does not start the charger.

cell_id.name: Battery ID
cell_id.description: Provide a battery record ID. Omit this field to clear the slot assignment.

start_quality_test.name: Start battery test
start_quality_test.description: Run measurements for the batteries assigned to the selected slots. A quality test includes charging, capacity measurement, recharging, resistance measurement, and storage mode when supported. Rest periods between phases are included.

slots.name: Multiple slots
slots.description: A list of integer slot numbers, for example [1, 2, 3, 4]. Specify this field or a single slot.

test_type.name: Test type
test_type.description: Each selected slot uses its assigned battery.

self_discharge.name: Observe self-discharge
self_discharge.description: For quality tests only: compare voltage after 24 hours following stabilization. This measures voltage change, not a percentage of lost capacity.

pause_quality_test.name: Pause test
pause_quality_test.description: Pause the test and stop the physical program in the selected slots. Explicitly resuming restarts the current phase from the beginning.

slots.name: Multiple slots
slots.description: A list of integer slot numbers, for example [1, 2, 3, 4]. Specify this field or a single slot.

resume_quality_test.name: Resume test
resume_quality_test.description: Resume a paused test from the beginning of its current phase. The same assigned battery must still be installed in the slot.

slots.name: Multiple slots
slots.description: A list of integer slot numbers, for example [1, 2, 3, 4]. Specify this field or a single slot.

cancel_quality_test.name: Cancel test
cancel_quality_test.description: Mark the test as cancelled, retain the available results, and stop the selected slots.

slots.name: Multiple slots
slots.description: A list of integer slot numbers, for example [1, 2, 3, 4]. Specify this field or a single slot.

export_quality_report.name: Export report
export_quality_report.description: Return the report contents, MIME type, and suggested filename in the action response. This does not start the charger.

report_id.name: Report ID
report_id.description: The id of the desired report in the reports attribute of the battery library sensor.

format.name: Format
format.description: JSON contains the complete data; CSV contains measurements; Markdown provides a summary; SVG plots voltage.
